CosmosDb._comment: AccountEndpoint/AccountKey deliberately omitted here — set per-environment (appsettings.Development.json locally, gitignored; app settings on the deployed App Service). DatabaseName/container names below are safe defaults (this project's PB_ prefix), not secrets.

GoogleAuth._comment: ClientId deliberately omitted here — same VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID gap noted in deployment.md. Set via appsettings.Development.json locally or the GoogleAuth__ClientId app setting in Azure once a real Client ID exists.

BlobStorage._comment: AccountUrl deliberately omitted here — set per-environment, same pattern as CosmosDb above.

Email._comment: SmtpHost/Username/Password deliberately blank — SmtpEmailService.IsConfigured is false until all three are set (appsettings.Development.json locally or Email__SmtpHost/Email__Username/Email__Password app settings in Azure), so welcome emails just no-op (logged, not sent) until a real GoDaddy mailbox exists. Expected: SmtpHost=smtpout.secureserver.net, SmtpPort=587.
